notes: Navy bar with the machine number in white Ubuntu Medium 7.06 mm (example BSG-i1). The sheet holds the sticker twice, identical. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
